def main():
    s = input().strip()
    if not s:
        return
    res = [s[0]]
    at_replaced = False
    i = 1
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        if not at_replaced and i < n - 2 and s[i] == 'a' and s[i+1] == 't':
            res.append('@')
            at_replaced = True
            i += 1
        elif i < n - 3 and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            res.append('.')
            i += 2
        else:
            res.append(s[i])
        i += 1
    print(''.join(res))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
